theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.generic_of_pos {X : Type u_1} {S : Set X} {q : X → ℂ} (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ (t : ℝ), 0 < t ∧ q x = ↑t) :
S ∩ {x : X | q x ≠ 1} ⊆ S ∩ {x : X | GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (q x)}

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.sep_of_pos {X : Type u_1} {S : Set X} {q : X → ℂ} {n : ℕ} (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ (t : ℝ), 0 < t ∧ q x = ↑t) (x : X) :
x ∈ S → Set.InjOn (qInt2 (q x)) {d : ℤ | d ∈ contentRange n}

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.projFamily_conj {X : Type u_1} {q : X → ℂ} {n : ℕ} {m : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (ρ : (x : X) → Hecke ℂ (q x) (q x)⁻¹ n →ₐ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) {lam' : (n + 1).Partition} {ρ' : (x : X) → Hecke ℂ (q x) (q x)⁻¹ n →ₐ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ} {x₀ : X} (U : (Matrix m m ℂ)ˣ) (hU : ∀ (i : Fin n), ↑U * (ρ x₀) (Hecke.σ ℂ (q x₀) (q x₀)⁻¹ n i) = (ρ' x₀) (Hecke.σ ℂ (q x₀) (q x₀)⁻¹ n i) * ↑U) (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau (Mathlib.partitionShape lam')) :
↑U * projFamily ρ T x₀ = projFamily ρ' T x₀ * ↑U

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.isIdempotentElem_projFamily {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {q : X → ℂ} {n : ℕ} {m : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (ρ : (x : X) → Hecke ℂ (q x) (q x)⁻¹ n →ₐ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) {lam' : (n + 1).Partition} (hq : ContinuousOn q S) (hq0 : ∀ x ∈ S, q x ≠ 0) (hsep : ∀ x ∈ S, Set.InjOn (qInt2 (q x)) {d : ℤ | d ∈ contentRange n}) (hρ : ∀ (i : Fin n), ContinuousOn (fun (x : X) => (ρ x) (Hecke.σ ℂ (q x) (q x)⁻¹ n i)) S) (hdense : S ⊆ closure (S ∩ {x : X | GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (q x)})) (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau (Mathlib.partitionShape lam')) (x : X) :
x ∈ S → IsIdempotentElem (projFamily ρ T x)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.continuousOn_projFamily {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {q : X → ℂ} {n : ℕ} {m : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (ρ : (x : X) → Hecke ℂ (q x) (q x)⁻¹ n →ₐ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) {lam' : (n + 1).Partition} (hq : ContinuousOn q S) (hq0 : ∀ x ∈ S, q x ≠ 0) (hsep : ∀ x ∈ S, Set.InjOn (qInt2 (q x)) {d : ℤ | d ∈ contentRange n}) (hρ : ∀ (i : Fin n), ContinuousOn (fun (x : X) => (ρ x) (Hecke.σ ℂ (q x) (q x)⁻¹ n i)) S) (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau (Mathlib.partitionShape lam')) :
ContinuousOn (projFamily ρ T) S

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.projFamily_eq_wedderburn {X : Type u_1} {q : X → ℂ} {n : ℕ} {m : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (ρ : (x : X) → Hecke ℂ (q x) (q x)⁻¹ n →ₐ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) {lam' : (n + 1).Partition} (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau (Mathlib.partitionShape lam')) (x : X) (hx0 : q x ≠ 0) (hgen : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (q x)) :
(ρ x) ((heckeWedderburn (q x) hx0 hgen n).symm (Pi.single lam' (Matrix.single T T 1))) = projFamily ρ T x

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.projFamily_eq_map {X : Type u_1} {q : X → ℂ} {n : ℕ} {m : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (ρ : (x : X) → Hecke ℂ (q x) (q x)⁻¹ n →ₐ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) {lam' : (n + 1).Partition} (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau (Mathlib.partitionShape lam')) (x : X) :
projFamily ρ T x = (ρ x) (jmProjIn (q x) (Hecke.σ ℂ (q x) (q x)⁻¹ n) (contentVec T))

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.projFamily {X : Type u_1} {q : X → ℂ} {n : ℕ} {m : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (ρ : (x : X) → Hecke ℂ (q x) (q x)⁻¹ n →ₐ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) {lam' : (n + 1).Partition} (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau (Mathlib.partitionShape lam')) (x : X) :
Matrix m m ℂ

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.intertwine_jmProjIn {K : Type u_2} [Field K] (q : K) {A : Type u_3} [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {n : ℕ} (g g' : Fin n → A) (U : A) (hU : ∀ (i : Fin n), U * g i = g' i * U) (c : ℕ → ℤ) :
U * jmProjIn q g c = jmProjIn q g' c * U

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.intertwine_list_prod {A : Type u_3} [Ring A] {α : Type u_4} (l : List α) (F F' : α → A) (U : A) (hF : ∀ a ∈ l, U * F a = F' a * U) :
U * (List.map F l).prod = (List.map F' l).prod * U

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.intertwine_jmAddIn {K : Type u_2} [Field K] (q : K) {A : Type u_3} [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {n : ℕ} (g g' : Fin n → A) (U : A) (hU : ∀ (i : Fin n), U * g i = g' i * U) (k : ℕ) :
U * jmAddIn q g k = jmAddIn q g' k * U

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.isIdempotentElem_of_closure {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {R : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace R] [T2Space R] [Semiring R] [ContinuousMul R] {e : X → R} (he : ContinuousOn e S) {G : Set X} (hG : ∀ x ∈ S ∩ G, IsIdempotentElem (e x)) (hdense : S ⊆ closure (S ∩ G)) (x : X) :
x ∈ S → IsIdempotentElem (e x)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.qInt2_injective_ofReal {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.notRootOfUnity_ofReal {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t ≠ 1) :
